verdict.rationale: Calendly documents a REST-based API v2 with resource-oriented URLs. Through it you can book meetings end-to-end via the Scheduling API, create event types (`POST /event_types`) and read event-type availability to build custom calendar views. Webhooks with signing keys and PAT/OAuth auth support embedding scheduling in your own product. Missing for 10: evidence of writing or updating availability schedules via the API (only reading is shown), evidence of updating or deleting event types, and independent or hands-on developer corroboration.
